resources.string: Review and synchronize your authorized call history, SMS activity, and encrypted recordings across your own devices with full transparency.
Nothing is collected or synced until you grant permission and enable each activity scope.
SMS payloads and imported recordings are encrypted at rest with Android Keystore AES-256-GCM.
All cloud records are scoped to your verified Google account and protected by zero-trust rules.
Connect Activity lets you view your own call and SMS activity remotely. Review how data is handled before continuing.
Only categories you opt into: call log metadata (number, contact name if permitted, date, duration, type), authorized or user-imported SMS records, and audio recordings you explicitly add.
Authorized records are cached locally, deduplicated by SHA-256 hash, and synced over HTTPS to your isolated Cloud Firestore account via WorkManager.
Every connected device is visible to you. You can inspect, export, revoke consent, or permanently delete cloud data at any time.
Call recording is not supported by this device or current Android configuration.

Android 10+ restricts cellular call audio capture to privileged system dialers. Connect Activity never uses Accessibility Services, hidden APIs, or silent microphone capture. You may lawfully import authorized recordings from a supported system recorder into your encrypted vault.
Direct SMS access requires eligible Android permissions. You can always import an authorized SMS JSON or CSV export without granting broad device permissions.
Grant Call Log permission and tap Refresh to view authorized call history.
Import a JSON/CSV message export or scan authorized device SMS.
Import an authorized audio recording to encrypt it with Android Keystore and manage cloud sync consent.
